mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.LoginMapper.selectUserByEmail */ user_uid, user_email, user_pwd, user_role FROM seinfo_vendor_manager WHERE user_email = #{userEmail}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.LoginMapper.selectUsrInfo */ a.user_uid , a.user_email , a.user_nm , a.user_pwd , a.user_role , CASE WHEN a.user_pwd_ch_d is null then date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE a.user_pwd_ch_d END AS user_pwd_ch_d , CASE WHEN a.user_login_d is null then date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE a.user_login_d END AS user_login_d , CASE WHEN a.fail_dt is null then DATE(now()) ELSE date(a.fail_dt) END AS fail_dt , 'Y' AS use_yn , a.user_pwd_init_yn , a.bl_yn , a.bl_reason , (SELECT zci.code_nm FROM zzz_code_info zci WHERE zci.code_parent_id = 'RTPC014' AND zci.code_value = 'MANAGER') as bl_manager , (SELECT zci.code_nm FROM zzz_code_info zci WHERE zci.code_parent_id = 'RTPC014' AND zci.code_value = 'MANAGER_MAIL') as bl_mail , a.fail_cnt , CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, IFNULL(a.fail_dt, DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)), now()) >= 30 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS un_locking /* 30분 경과시 계정잠금해제 : 'Y' */ , (30 - TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, IFNULL(a.fail_dt, now()), now())) as waiting_time , b.company_no , b.company_nm FROM seinfo_vendor_manager a JOIN seinfo_vendor b ON a.company_no = b.company_no WHERE user_email = #{userEmail}
mapper.update: update /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.LoginMapper.updateUsrLoginSuccess */ seinfo_vendor_manager set fail_cnt = 0 , fail_dt = null , user_login_d = now() , mod_dt = now() , mod_user_id = #{userEmail} where user_uid = #{userUid}
mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.main.mapper.LoginMapper.findUsrInfoByUid */ user_email , user_pwd FROM seinfo_vendor_manager WHERE user_uid = #{userUid}
